data.name: Touch of Darkness
data.description: As a melee touch attack, you can cause a creature's vision to be fraught with shadows and darkness. The creature touched treats all other creatures as if they had concealment, suffering a 20%% miss chance on all attack rolls. This effect lasts for %1 rounds. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|max(DomainDarknessLVL/2,1)|TouchofDarknessTimes
